ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level dominance of low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) across the fluke body with a very low ratio of high-intensity pixels (white), restricted to localized spots and water turbulence at the peduncle interface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark pigmentation field across the majority of the visible surface; presence of isolated, high-contrast white circular blobs on the left ventral lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a high depth-to-width ratio and a sharp vertex angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, low-frequency serrations along the trailing edge, culminating in severe, high-amplitude jagged protrusions and irregular tissue loss at both distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge transitioning to a steep upward sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of at least four distinct, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters located on the mid-to-lower section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe structural irregularity and erosion at the distal tips of both lobes; the right lobe tip exhibits significant jagged appendages and dark, clustered surface protrusions.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a distinct, irregular dark structure or growth hanging from the extreme edge of the right lobe tip.
